claim_traces.claim_title: Generative AI will replace 300 million jobs
claim_traces.claim_text: "Generative AI will replace 300 million jobs worldwide."
reasoning_steps: The claim distorts the findings of a widely cited March 2023 Goldman Sachs report authored by Joseph Briggs and Devesh Kodnani (and Jan Hatzius et al.)

The report did not predict that generative AI "will replace 300 million jobs." Instead, it estimated that generative AI could expose the equivalent of roughly 300 million full-time jobs across major economies to automation

Crucially, the authors distinguished between job replacement and task automation, noting that most occupations and workers are only partially exposed and are more likely to be complemented by AI rather than substituted

The study also emphasized that technological displacement is historically balanced by the creation of new occupations, predicting a potential boost in global GDP rather than a net loss of 300 million positions
Presenting this figure as a definitive prediction of direct job losses mischaracterizes the report's methodology and conclusions.
